svg.title: Tam-AI-Ti, a te reo Māori AI coach for financial wellbeing built on the Māori holistic-health model Te Whare Tapa Whā, developed solo by Chan Meng as a development commission from Riria (Missy) Te Kanawa. Six parts of the product in turn: a daily whakataukī and check-in, the maramataka calendar, goals with action plans, a hauora journal filled in by voice, a voice coach, and whānau support with permissions the user sets. A 19-person research cohort used it over four months: 181 bilingual journal entries and 35 voice coaching sessions. The interface shown is recreated in code; the demo account and figures are illustrative.
